summary: Iteration 7 verified: XLSX embedded logo width is now capped at 60% of the visible table pixel width (min 30%) and stays horizontally centered within the table via OneCellAnchor for both Patuma (aspect ~14.6:1) and Clearfreight (aspect ~9.4:1). Row 1 height >= 60. All iter 6 regressions still green (append-comment DD.MM prefix, mark-shipped/mark-delayed prefix refresh, seeded initial comment prefix, Comments column width 32). PDF export still returns 200 with logo (>=40KB) for both companies. 11/11 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1025 lines; splitting XLSX/PDF helpers into modules would help maintainability.

target_w_px formula: min(int(total_px*0.6), int(100*aspect)) — for tall/square logos (aspect near 1) this caps width at 100px which may look small; consider basing the width cap on max(target_h_px*aspect_upper) instead. Not a bug for current Patuma/CF wide banners.

target_h_px = max(50, int(target_w_px/aspect)) has no explicit max=100 cap in code even though request statement mentions max 100; for extreme aspects the 60% width cap + 100px width-per-unit-aspect ceiling keeps height <= 100 for aspect>=1, but if a taller-than-wide logo were ever supplied, height could exceed 100. Consider adding min(100, ...) for safety.
